claims.scope: Streaming e-commerce events with bursty user query arrivals on M3 Air architecture.
Equal-budget FIFO batch allocation on unified memory architecture under identical query cohorts.
Cold entity feature synthesis under dynamic stream transport without historical interactions.
Hyperparameter perturbation envelope across plus-minus 50 percent under nominal query load.
Linear scoring models with stateful EMA feature extractors across full 2x2 factorial matrix.

data_provenance.assessment: Author-declared Tianchi UserBehavior dataset canonicalization with verified cryptographic SHA-256 digests.

reproducibility.assessment: Deterministic clean-checkout reproduction manifest verifying 12 primary headline metrics within 1e-5 tolerance.

baselines.assessment: Prospective hyperparameter selection on validation data establishes U*=20 as the optimal static trade-off.
Matches dynamic MIMD write work envelope to within 1 percent (WWR=0.3302) using uniform periodic batching.

ablations.assessment: Full 2x2 factorial decomposition isolates cadence throttling from feature memory adaptation with near-zero synergy.

limitations: Evaluation is restricted to a single admitted real-world e-commerce event stream trace.
Single-node CPU thread execution envelope without distributed network transport latency.
Gains over static batching are concentrated in high-activity burst interaction regimes.
